description: Jupiter’s retrograde motion ends around March 10, 2026, when the giant planet appears to reverse direction in the sky. The effect is caused by Earth overtaking Jupiter in its orbit. The bright planet will shine in Gemini near Castor and Pollux throughout March.
title: Jupiter Resumes Direct Motion This March as the Gas Giant Hits Peak Visibility for 2026 Skywatchers

description: Some stories start gently and then gradually become deeper and more mysterious, often captivating the audience with unexpected twists and complex character developments. Ravam: Sound of Soul follows a similar path. The film begins as a warm, feel-good story; however, it eventually shifts into an intense thriller filled with suspense and hidden truths. It premiered March 6, 2026, on Aha Video as an Aha Original.
title: Ravam: Sound of Soul Streaming on AhaVideo: What You Need to Know About This New Horror Thriller

description: Mardaani 3 is set to release on OTT following its theatrical run. The film is the third instalment in the Mardaani trilogy, a gritty cop drama that marks the return of Senior IPS Officer Shivani Shivaji Roy. The plot revolves around a harrowing case involving the mysterious disappearance of 93 girls over three months. Viewers can see Mardaani 3 online on Netflix from March 27, 2026.
title: Mardaani 3 Set for OTT Release Soon: What You Need to Know About Shivani Shivaji Roy’s Return

description: Samsung is reportedly testing high-capacity silicon-carbon smartphone batteries, including 12,000mAh and 18,000mAh prototypes, according to a tipster. A larger 20,000mAh prototype reportedly failed durability tests after about 960 charge cycles. The 12,000mAh version uses a dual-cell design, while the 18,000mAh model uses three cells. Samsung SDI is said to be refining cell stacking and battery management systems as testing continues. Silicon-carbon batteries can store more energy than lithium-ion cells, potentially enabling thinner smartphones with significantly larger battery capacities in future devices.
title: Samsung Testing 12,000mAh, 18,000mAh Batteries With Dual Cell and Triple Cell Designs, Leaked Reports Show

description: Laser printers are widely used in homes and small offices due to their fast speeds, reliable performance, and lower long-term printing costs. This list highlights some of the best colour and monochrome laser printers available in India in 2026. Models from HP, Canon, and Brother offer features such as automatic duplex printing, wireless connectivity, and multifunction support for scanning and copying. The printers cater to different needs and budgets, with print speeds ranging from 18 to 34 pages per minute and prices starting at Rs. 15,999.
title: Best Colour and Monochrome Laser Printers for Home, Small Office Usage in 2026

description: Launched in January, Chrome’s Auto Browse turns Gemini into an agent that navigates websites, clicks buttons, and completes actions on your behalf. Available now to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in the US, it works through the Gemini side panel and keeps users in control with confirmations and permissions.
title: How to use Gemini-Powered Auto browse Feature on Google Chrome

description: The next-gen Xbox, codenamed Project Helix, could cost around $1,000 or more, according to a leaker. Microsoft has previously said that its next console will be a “very premium, very high-end curated experience.” According to a new report, the console could cost up to $1,200.
title: Microsoft Could Reportedly Price Next-Gen Xbox 'Project Helix' at $1,000 or More

description: OnePlus 15T will be available for purchase in China in “White Chocolate” (translated from Chinese) colour option, along with the recently announced “Pure Cocoa” (brown) and “Relaxing Matcha” (green) shades, the company announced on Tuesday. The handset is scheduled to be launched in China later this month. The phone is now available for pre-order in the country via the Oppo China online store. It is confirmed to sport a 6.32-inch display, along with 1.1mm thick bezels.
title: OnePlus 15T White Colourway, Key Display Features Revealed as Company Opens Pre-Orders in China

description: Directed by Goutham Krishna, Yogi Da is a Tamil action-thriller film that centres on an honest and tough female police inspector. This film is set to drop on March 13th, 2026, exclusively on Aha Tamil. Viewers will require an active subscription to stream it online. The film was theatrically released on February 6, 2026, where it received a remarkable response at the box office.
title: Yogi Da OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Sai Dhanshika and Kabir Duhan Singh Starrer Online?

description: Written and directed by Fatih Akin, Amrum is a German historical drama film set against the backdrop of the last few days of World War II. The film centres on a young protagonist navigating his life through a disturbing atmosphere as the Nazi regime comes to an end. This film is now available to stream exclusively on Amazon Prime Video. It is available in Deutch language, with English subtitles.
title: Amrum Begins Streaming on OTT Online: All You Need to Know About Fatih Akin’s Cannes-Premiered War Drama

description: Infinix GT 50 Pro 5G real-life images have been shared by a tech blogger, revealing the phone’s design. Additionally, the smartphone has reportedly been spotted on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) database, suggesting that the rumoured Infinix could be launched soon in the country. The phone is shown to carry a dual rear camera unit, housed inside a rectangular camera island. Moreover, it could feature a SIM tray on the bottom. The smartphone is tipped to sport a 50-megapixel main camera on the back.
title: Infinix GT 50 Pro 5G Real-Life Images Surface Online as Smartphone Arrives on BIS Database

description: Lenovo Tab Plus Gen 2 renders have surfaced online, suggesting that the tech firm could be planning significant design changes for the tablet. The device is expected to succeed the Lenovo Tab Plus, which was launched in select global markets in June 2024. The purported Lenovo Tab Plus Gen 2 is shown to sport a huge speaker outlet on the back with JBL branding. Around the circular speaker, the tablet could ship with an in-built kickstand. Moreover, the tech firm could place the power button and volume controls on the back of the tablet, along with a single rear camera.
title: Lenovo Tab Plus Gen 2 Spotted in Leaked Renders That Point to Significant Design Overhaul

description: Microsoft introduced Copilot Cowork, an agentic AI tool for enterprises, on Monday. Built using Anthropic’s Claude artificial intelligence (AI) models and the Work IQ intelligence layer, the tool is aimed at transforming Copilot’s capabilities from chats to actions. In practice, it will gain agentic capabilities by drawing context from the Microsoft 365 suite of applications and then performing these tasks without needing connectors or complex integration with enterprise systems.
title: Microsoft’s New Copilot Cowork Can Take Actions and Autonomously Complete Tasks

description: Thai crypto operators have frozen more than 10,000 accounts suspected of involvement in money laundering and scam-related transactions. The move follows tighter screening measures introduced by regulators and industry groups. Authorities say enhanced monitoring, stronger Know Your Customer procedures, and data sharing between exchanges, banks, and law enforcement helped identify suspicious activity across multiple platforms.
title: Thailand Targets Crypto Mule Accounts Linked to Scams, Illegal Transfers as Authorities Freeze 10,000 Wallets

description: Bhutan's government has moved 175 BTC worth about $11.85 million (roughly Rs. 98 crore) from its national crypto holdings to a newly created wallet, according to Arkham Intelligence. Blockchain data indicates the receiving address had previously received Bitcoin from government-linked wallets. Analysts say such movements are often linked to internal treasury management or preparations for institutional sales. Bhutan is currently among the largest nation-state holders of Bitcoin.
title: Bhutan Moves Over $11 Million Worth of Bitcoin From Government Holdings, Arkham Data Shows

description: Oppo Find X9 Ultra and Oppo Find X9s have reportedly received NBTC certification in Thailand, suggesting an upcoming global launch. According to a report, the handsets were listed with model numbers CPH2841 and CPH2873. Oppo has confirmed that the Find X9 Ultra will launch in select global markets later this year, marking the brand’s first Ultra model to debut outside China. The report also claims the Find X9s could use the Dimensity 9500s chipset, while the Find X9 Ultra may be priced around Rs. 1,40,000.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra, Find X9s Reportedly Bag Thailand's NBTC Certification Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 Pro will be launched in India on March 19 at 12 pm IST by the Chinese tech firm. The upcoming true wireless stereo (TWS) will be available for purchase in the country soon after its launch via Flipkart, Amazon, and the OnePlus India online store. It will be offered in Radiant Gray and Raven Black colour options. As part of the announcement, the company has also revealed the key specifications and features of the OnePlus Nord Buds 4 Pro.
title: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 Pro India Launch Date, Key Features and Availability Details Announced

description: The Oppo K14x 5G was launched in India in February as the first model in the latest K14 lineup. The brand has now introduced a new RAM and storage configuration for the handset. Customers can now purchase the Oppo K14x 5G’s new base variant with 4GB RAM and 64GB onboard storage. The company says it aims to make the handset more accessible to value-conscious buyers such as students and first-time smartphone users.
title: Oppo K14x 5G Gets New 4GB RAM, 64GB Storage Variant in India: Price, Specifications

description: Shinji Mikami's new studio is called Unbound Games, according to the company's website. The studio is now working on its first project, an original new IP. Unbound will work on AAA games developed for PC, PS5, and Xbox. The studio is now hiring developers to work on its first project.
title: Shinji Mikami's New Studio, Unbound Games, Is Working on 'New Original IP' for PC, PS5 and Xbox

description: Vivo has revealed new details about the telephoto system of the upcoming Vivo X300 Ultra. The handset will feature built-in lenses covering 14mm, 35mm, 85mm, and 200mm focal lengths, with optional Zeiss teleconverter accessories extending the range to 400mm. One accessory, called the "Big Gun" 400, supports high magnification and 200-megapixel optical output with up to 17.4x zoom. Vivo also introduced a lighter "Lipstick" 200mm teleconverter weighing 153g. The system includes 3-degree optical stabilisation, supports CIPA stabilisation ratings, and offers 14 shooting modes for photography and video.
title: Vivo Product Manager Teases Vivo X300 Ultra's 400mm Teleconverter Kit Performance Ahead of Debut

description: Bitcoin moved back above the $70,000 level on Tuesday as the crypto market showed early signs of stabilisation after recent volatility. Analysts said the rebound reflects cautious consolidation supported by on-chain accumulation and steady institutional interest. Ethereum remains under pressure in a broader downtrend, while major altcoins tracked Bitcoin’s movement. Experts noted that key support and resistance zones will determine the market’s next direction.
title: Bitcoin Rises Above $70,000 as Crypto Rally Offers Temporary Market Stability

description: OpenAI announced its plans to acquire the artificial intelligence (AI) security platform Promptfoo on Monday. The San Francisco-based AI giant said that it was in the process of finalising the deal, which is currently subject to customary closing conditions. The acquisition will allow the ChatGPT maker to integrate Promptfoo’s technology stack into OpenAI Frontier, an enterprise-grade platform designed to build, deploy, and manage fleets of AI agents.
title: OpenAI to Acquire AI Security Platform Promptfoo, Build New Enterprise Capabilities in Frontier

description: Poco C85x 5G has been launched in India by the Xiaomi sub-brand as the second model in the company’s C85 lineup. The phone is scheduled to go on sale in the country on March 14 at 12 pm IST via Flipkart. The new Poco C85x 5G will be available for purchase in Black, Gold, and Green colour options. It will be offered in 4GB+64GB and 4GB+128GB RAM and storage configurations. The handset is backed by a 6,300mAh battery. It also features a dual rear camera unit, headlined by a 32-megapixel primary shooter.
title: Poco C85x 5G Launched in India With 6,300mAh Battery, 32-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: The launch of the PlayStation 5 Pro (PS5 Pro) in India could finally be on the horizon, nearly two years after its global debut. Sony’s upgraded version of its popular gaming console was first launched in select markets in November 2024, but regulatory hurdles had pushed back its release in India. Now, a new development suggests the wait may soon be over, as a listing of the PS5 Pro has been spotted on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) website.
title: PS5 Pro India Launch Seems Imminent as Console Appears on BIS Database

description: The Vivo T5x 5G will be launched in India next week, the company announced on Tuesday. The successor to the Vivo T4x 5G, which was introduced in March 2025, will be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Turbo chipset. The brand claims its upcoming handset will offer the largest battery life in its segment, while also having an IP68 + IP69-rated build for dust and water resistance. It is confirmed to run on Android 16-based OriginOS 6.
title: Vivo T5x 5G India Launch Date Announced; to Feature Dimensity 7400 Turbo Chip, 7,200mAh Battery

description: Anthropic introduced a new artificial intelligence (AI)-powered coding tool on Monday, aimed at reviewing pull requests (PRs) before they are deployed. Dubbed Code Review, it is available as a new tool in Claude Code, and it can be activated for specific or all repositories. The company said the tool uses a multi-agent review system and is designed to be thorough.
title: Anthropic Introduces Agentic Code Review Tool to Claude Code

description: EA has laid off workers at its Battlefield teams across Criterion, Dice, Ripple Effect, and Motive Studios. The company did not specify the number of employees impacted by the layoffs. The layoffs come even as Battlefield 6 had a record-breaking launch for EA.
title: EA Lays Off Workers Across Battlefield Studios Despite Battlefield 6's 'Record Breaking Success'

description: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold will be equipped with a redesigned rear camera module, as per the leaked computer-aided design (CAD) renders of the phone. The purported renders were shared online by Android Headlines. The rumoured foldable from the Mountain View-based company is shown to feature a rectangular deco on the back, featuring two pill-shaped camera modules to house a triple rear camera unit. The company could reposition the LED flash to the left of the camera island. It appears to sport similar hole punch display cutouts on the cover and foldable screens as the Pixel 10 Pro Fold.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold Could Launch With a Redesigned External Camera Module, Leaked Renders Suggest

description: Xiaomi Pad 8 was launched in India on Tuesday as the company’s latest flagship Android tablet. It features an 11-inch 3.2K display with a 144Hz refresh rate and up to 800 nits brightness, along with support for Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos. The tablet is powered by the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset, paired with LPDDR5T RAM and UFS 4.1 storage. It packs a 9,200mAh battery with 45W fast charging and runs Xiaomi HyperOS with AI features and cross-device connectivity support.
title: Xiaomi Pad 8 Launched in India With Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 SoC, 9,200mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Apple now assembles about 25 percent of the total iPhone units in India, according to a Bloomberg report. This reportedly comes as the Cupertino-based tech giant continues to shift its manufacturing base from China to other regions due to multiple reasons, including geopolitics. The company is said to annually produce between 220 million and 230 million smartphone units. In 2025, the tech giant, through its contract manufacturers, including Foxconn, Tata Electronics, and Pegatron, assembles about 55 million units. This comes months after a Union Minister announced that the company shipped $16 million worth of iPhone models from India in the first nine months of FY26.
title: Apple Reportedly Assembled 25 Percent of 230 Million iPhone Units in India in 2025

description: iQOO reportedly teased the upcoming iQOO Z11 smartphone in China during its seventh anniversary event. The handset is confirmed to feature a 165Hz gaming display and a 9,020mAh battery, the largest ever used in an iQOO phone. The device has also appeared on certification sites, suggesting an imminent launch. Leaks indicate it may sport a 6.83-inch 1.5K display, support 90W fast charging, and offer a 16GB + 512GB configuration. The iQOO Z11 is expected to launch in China later this month.
title: iQOO Z11 Teased With 165Hz Display, 9,020mAh Battery; China Launch Expected Soon

description: Apple is said to have pushed back the launch of its long-rumoured smart home display, as the development of planned AI features continues to lag behind. According to a seasoned journalist, the Cupertino-based tech giant has postponed the purported device because the upgraded version of Siri that powers many of its AI capabilities is not yet ready. The delay highlights Apple’s broader challenges in finalising its next generation of AI-powered features that are expected to power several upcoming devices.
title: Apple Reportedly Delays Smart Home Display Due to Unfinished AI Features; iPhone 18 Pro to Bring New Siri

description: Apple is said to have finalised its plans for the next-generation entry-level smartphone in its lineup, ubiquitously known as the iPhone 18e. According to a tipster, the Cupertino-based tech giant has already locked in development plans for the purported handset even before the new iPhone 17e is publicly available for purchase. Previous reports indicate that Apple may launch only three iPhone models this year, breaking away from a pattern that has continued since 2020.
title: Apple Said to Finalise iPhone 18e Plans With Dynamic Island Upgrade and 2027 Launch Window, Tipster Claims
